name: smart-autocomplete
description: Statistics-aware smart autocomplete: filters a local dictionary of identifiers, then ranks candidates with a small local LLM (Ollama / OpenAI-compatible).

smartAutocomplete.debounceMs.description: Delay (ms) after the last keystroke before candidates are filtered and the local LLM is queried.

smartAutocomplete.llmTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for the local LLM. On timeout, frequency-ranked candidates are shown.

smartAutocomplete.llmUrl.description: Base URL of the local LLM server.

smartAutocomplete.llmModel.description: Model name on the local server (e.g. qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, gemma2:2b, phi3.5:3.8b).

smartAutocomplete.maxCandidates.description: How many prefix-filtered dictionary entries are sent to the LLM (top-N by usage score).

smartAutocomplete.topN.description: How many completions to ask the LLM to return.

smartAutocomplete.contextLines.description: How many lines of code above the cursor are sent to the LLM as context.

smartAutocomplete.mode.description: How completions are shown. 'inline' (default) — hybrid: the best candidate is ghost text (Tab accepts, Alt+]/Alt+[ cycles) and the remaining candidates open in the regular suggest dropdown; 'widget' — the whole ranked list in the dropdown, no ghost text.

smartAutocomplete.suppressBuiltInSuggest.description: Automatically set editor.quickSuggestions=false (global setting) so no suggest dropdown auto-pops while typing — only the ghost text appears, the dropdown is available via Ctrl+Space. The previous value is restored when the plugin or inline mode is disabled. Default false: the dropdown with the remaining candidates auto-pops together with the ghost text.
